news.title: Jeeves raises $110M to take its stablecoin play global
Jeeves raises $110M to build stablecoin wallet and AI agents

bullets: Own the stablecoin product roadmap: which rails to build on, which stablecoins to support, and how they integrate into payments and treasury workflows
Build institutional-grade infrastructure that abstracts blockchain complexity while preserving speed and cost advantages for end users
Drive the full product lifecycle from ideation through launch, collaborating with engineering, design, legal, compliance, and commercial teams
Build products that let businesses send, receive, convert, and hold stablecoins alongside fiat across USD, EUR, BRL, MXN, and local currency corridors
Design seamless on/off-ramp flows that feel as simple as traditional banking, even for users who have never touched crypto
